name: Setite Sorcery (The Immanence of Set) — 3 Advanced — Dark Invocation

system.description:
For thousands of years the people of Egypt warded their tombs and treasuries with curses invoking the gods' vengeance. This power lets a Setite lay just such a curse on a person, object or place.

System: To curse a person, the Setite must know the victim's name, and if the target is another vampire, possess a drop of her blood. The Setite first devises the curse's single specific effect and duration (no longer than one lunar cycle), then spends four Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait and wins a Mental challenge against the target's Willpower; success brings the curse into effect, with the margin of success generally serving as a difficulty penalty for the victim in relevant circumstances. To ward a place or object instead, the Setite must inscribe the curse's specific triggers, effect and duration around the warded item or threshold.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
